PR Summary by Qodo

Add Save all for received photos and videos ✨ Enhancement 🧪 Tests 📝 Documentation 🕐 20-40 Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Add Save all to share received files together or download them on laptops.
>• Skip files already handed over and leave unfinished transfers for a later tap.
>• Cover sharing, fallback downloads, and duplicate prevention with unit and browser tests.
>
Merge Risk 🟡 Medium

Blast radius 🟡 Medium 💥 2 capabilities

- 2 affected capabilities within one bounded functional scope: received-file-export. - The path begins at the changed individual save handler and ends at the browser share/download handoff. - It shares the same in-memory received-file inventory and download helper as bulk export, so this is one bounded browser integration rather than a separate deployment or storage scope. - The propagation path is confined to the browser's received-file export integration: the changed batch state machine consumes the page's files/prints/incoming maps and invokes the page's share/download boundary. - It is a distinct user operation from individual export, but both belong to the same bounded functional scope because they hand off the same received files and share the handed state.
Behavioral complexity 🔴 High 🧩 Interacting branches, Concurrent ordering

- Before, there was no bulk export state machine. - After, the behavior coordinates the handed set, downloadNext retry mode, busy re-entry guard, share cancellation versus other failures, ordered downloads separated by DOWNLOAD_GAP, and per-file marking after handoff. - The new correctness conditions are: a concurrent tap must not start another batch; a canceled share must preserve all files; a non-cancellation share failure must defer downloads to the next tap; files must be marked only after their individual handoff; and later batches must include only unmarked files. - These are newly interacting asynchronous states and ordering requirements, not merely reuse of browser share/download APIs.
Potential damage 🟢 Low 🩹 Reversible

- If the changed handler regresses, a user may be unable to export an otherwise available received file or may need to retry. - The received bytes and print metadata remain in browser memory, and restoring the handler or using the other export operation can recover the capability. - A share rejection is explicitly ignored by the individual path, so no persistent state repair or external compensation is required. - Recoverable by retrying while the received file remains available, or by restoring code. - No automatic retry worker or persistent repair mechanism is shown.
Assessed commit 24b587a
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD UI["Save all button"] --> Eligible["Eligible received files"] --> Route{"Batch share available?"} -->|yes| Share["Share sheet"] --> Handed["Handed-over IDs"] Route -->|no or retry| Downloads["Paced downloads"] --> Handed Share -.->|failure: next tap| Downloads ```
High-Level Assessment

>The following are alternative approaches to this PR:
1. Download one ZIP archive on laptops
- ➕ Requires only one browser download instead of a paced series. - ➖ Changes the saved files into an archive and adds packaging work and potential memory overhead.
>**Recommendation:** Keep the direct-download approach for this experiment: it preserves individual files and matches the intended Save all behavior. Consider a ZIP only if browser prompts or blocked downloads make paced downloads unreliable in practice.

1. Save all reports photos as saved before downloads run 📘 Rule violation ⭐ New
>
>Description >
> >
>In createSaveAll’s tap() download branch, the Saved ${ready.length} toast appears before any
>downloads start, and the count does not change when a download throws. Because the catch only logs
>the error and leaves the failed photo out of handed, a batch with failed downloads reports the
>full count without telling the user which photos remain available to retry.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[R51-54]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/137/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR51-R54) > >```diff >+ toast(`Saved ${ready.length}${more(arriving)}`); >+ for (let i = 0; i < ready.length; i++) { >+ if (i) await wait(DOWNLOAD_GAP); >+ try { download(ready[i].file); handed.add(ready[i].pid); } catch (e) { console.warn('download failed', ready[i].file?.name, e); } >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >In `createSaveAll`’s `tap()` download branch, the batch announces `Saved N` before downloads run and reports the full batch size even when some downloads throw. Failed photos remain available to retry, but the user receives no indication of the failure. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/saveall.js[50-56] >- web/index.html[336-342] >- tests/saveall.test.mjs[177-193] > >## Recommended Fix >Move the toast after the download loop. Track downloads that did not throw separately from caught failures, report an accurate count and any failures with a retry instruction, and keep `handed.add` only for successful downloads. Update `a photo is marked handed over only when its download starts` to assert the failure notification and reported count, and update the two-browser assertion to check the reported count against successful downloads. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >

2. Blocked downloads vanish from Save all 🐞 Bug ⭐ New
>
>Description >
> >
>downloadFile() treats an anchor click as a completed handoff, so tap() adds its PID to handed
>even when the browser blocks an automatic download without throwing. When multiple-download
>permission is denied, later files in a batch can be blocked while Save all says they were saved, and
>another tap excludes them as already handed over.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[R53-54]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/137/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR53-R54) > >```diff >+ if (i) await wait(DOWNLOAD_GAP); >+ try { download(ready[i].file); handed.add(ready[i].pid); } catch (e) { console.warn('download failed', ready[i].file?.name, e); } >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >An anchor click cannot confirm that the browser accepted a download, yet the batch permanently excludes that file from subsequent attempts. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/index.html[330-334] >- web/saveall.js[50-55] >## Recommended Fix >Do not equate a successful `a.click()` return with a confirmed download. Make the uncertainty and possible multiple-download permission prompt visible, and provide a user-initiated way to retry files that may have been blocked without silently classifying them as completed. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >

5. A stalled share blocks every later batch 🐞 Bug ⭐ New
>
>Description >
> >
>tap() clears busy only in finally after await share(list) settles, with no path to recover
>if that browser promise remains pending. In that case every later Save all tap returns “Still
>saving,” so the person cannot reach either a retry or the download fallback without reloading the
>tab.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[R41-43]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/137/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR41-R43) > >```diff >+ if (sharing) { >+ try { await share(list); } catch (e) { >+ if (e?.name === 'AbortError') return; // cancelled: nothing happens, the photos stay available >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >A share promise that never settles leaves Save all permanently busy. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/saveall.js[32-56] >- web/index.html[336-343] >## Recommended Fix >Detect an excessively long pending share and tell the person that its outcome is unknown. 7. Photos can download twice during Save all 🐞 Bug 👈 Shift left
>
>Description >
> >
>tap() keeps a fixed ready list across download gaps without rechecking whether save(p) has
>handed over an item. If someone taps an individual photo during that gap, its download starts and is
>marked handed over, but the batch downloads the same photo again.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[R53-54]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/137/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR53-R54) > >```diff >if (i) await wait(DOWNLOAD_GAP); >try { download(ready[i].file); handed.add(ready[i].pid); } catch (e) { console.warn('download failed', ready[i].file?.name, e); } >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >An individual photo can be handed over while Save all is waiting between downloads, and the batch then hands it over again.
